provenance_note: Retrofitted from already approved planning artifacts after the run omitted the established provenance IDs. This ledger records existing authority; it does not add or reinterpret scope.
product_target: A reusable Rust and Bevy voxel-world substrate, not a playable game.

claims.statement: Moria is reusable Rust and Bevy voxel-world substrate infrastructure, not a playable game.
Contracts are volume-general; ships and stations are future-consumer examples, not current delivery targets.
Consumers inspect and mutate authoritative matter only through supported public contracts.
Sparse cost follows interest and change rather than total theoretical world volume.
Every exposed material cell is mutable through admitted changes.
Deep Z is genuine volumetric material depth rather than heightmap presentation.
Dynamic material volumes move and mutate under the same truth contracts as static matter.
External behavior systems integrate through generic seams while owning their concepts, state, rules, and outcomes.
Persistence retains material truth and edit scars without requiring full untouched-volume dumps.
Authoritative matter remains GPU-resident behind an asynchronous-capable command and query boundary.
Presentation is derived from authoritative matter and depends on the consumer's world domain.
World generation is consumer-owned and is not part of substrate product identity.
Curation, benchmark, and visual-validation harnesses are adjacent consumers using the public interface.
Characters, controls, combat, AI, economy, game-specific presentation, and other game layers are downstream.
Correctness and substrate quality must be measurable before continuous optimization.
Collision and occupancy truth are evaluated against authoritative voxel matter, not disposable presentation.

decisions.question: Is a walkable-world visual validation harness mandatory current delivery?
Are natural-looking terrain, everywhere mutation, and first-class deep Z binding outcomes?
decisions.selected: Everywhere mutation and first-class deep Z are binding; presentation is domain-dependent.

decisions.question: Is GPU-resident and asynchronous-GPU-capable architecture binding?
Are ships and stations current delivery scope?
Must the substrate support dynamic voxel volumes?
Is deterministic or procedural world generation part of substrate product identity?
Are physics or damage behavior in product scope?
decisions.selected: Generic extension seams are in scope; behavior policy is not.

decisions.question: May one bounded multi-target matter mutation report partial application?
decisions.selected: No; it commits atomically at one revision or has no committed effect.
